intro: Over the past three months, ZCyberNews has tracked 58 articles under social-engineering, with 44 rated high severity and one critical. Lazarus Group, UNC6692, and APT37 (ScarCruft, InkySquid) were the most frequently observed threat actors, while CVE-2023-36036 was the top vulnerability. The primary sectors affected were cryptocurrency, financial services, technology, financial-services, and enterprise, with global impact and specific reports from North America, Europe, the United States, and Australia.
